That rival would weaken fullness if it retained OwnBeing for the same source, genuinely excluded an independently warranted pure OfBeing mode and justified the exclusion as non-contracting under the same act/recipient account. The finite controls isolate the disputed conditions and leave their metaphysical application unresolved. A finite implementation can revise the purity classification of its candidate without settling whole-power possession.
